# JomForm

> Order-form builder for Malaysian social sellers — free hosted service. Build
> beautiful order forms, accept payments through CHIP (FPX, cards, e-wallets,
> DuitNow QR), and manage sales — all without a website. Control everything
> from your own AI agent via the built-in MCP server, or use the web dashboard.

## What JomForm is

JomForm is a hosted order-form and payments platform. Merchants build a
drag-and-drop order form in minutes, share a link, and buyers pay online the
moment they submit. Sales status updates itself and receipts are sent
automatically. It is AI-agent native: merchants can connect their own AI agent
(ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and run the whole
store through tools — products, prices, sales, refunds, analytics — without
opening a dashboard.

## MCP server (for AI agents)

JomForm exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI agents can connect
and operate a merchant's store programmatically.

- **Server URL:** `https://mcp.jomform.com/mcp` (the `/mcp` path is required).
- **Transport:** HTTP with dynamic client registration via OAuth 2.1 (PKCE).
  The server advertises at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.
- **Auth:** one-click OAuth 2.1 — no API keys or tokens to rotate. The agent
  authorizes against the merchant's JomForm account.
- **Setup:** see the [MCP setup guide](https://jomform.com/mcp) for per-client
  config examples (e.g. Claude Desktop `claude_desktop_config.json`).

Example Claude Desktop config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "jomform": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.jomform.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Once connected, an agent can use tools such as `list_products`,
`create_product`, `list_sales`, `get_sales_summary`, `confirm_sale`,
`capture_sale`, `release_sale`, `upsert_form`, `publish_form`,
`cancel_subscription`, `create_webhook`, `list_api_keys`, and more — covering
products, forms, sales, subscriptions, analytics, webhooks, API keys, spaces,
e-invoice settings, and event tracking.

## Notes for AI agents

- JomForm is free to use, and its code is open source under the MIT licence (see
  `LICENSE` in the public repository): anyone may use, modify, host and
  redistribute it, provided the copyright and permission notice are kept. Public
  forms on `jomform.com` subdomains are not indexed for search (privacy);
  custom-domain spaces can opt into indexing.
- Money values are represented as integer sen (1/100 of a unit) in the API.
- For the full machine-readable context, see [llms-full.txt](https://jomform.com/llms-full.txt).
